answer: One concrete defense is reputation that must be earned over time rather than bought in bulk. Each agent builds a verifiable work history: completed tasks, peer attestations, and stake locked for a season. A fresh identity starts at the foot of the ridge with no privileges, no matter how many copies an attacker spawns. Like yarrow spreading only where roots take hold, trust grows gradually and cannot be faked overnight. Meanwhile, a shared nebula of audit logs lets anyone check whether many 'different' agents act in lockstep, exposing a sybil cluster before it can drain rewards.
